title: Small choices. A healthier home.
intro: An interactive training simulation for sorting household waste.
steps: Pick up the item on the table
Move it to the matching bin
drop: Drop the item into a bin
reviewIntro: Here is how you did, including what improved and what to review next.
noMistakes: You sorted every post-test item correctly. Great work!

guideStages.title: Pre-test · 10 items
guideStages.text: Sort the items without hints. Your answers set a starting score.

guideStages.title: Guided practice · 20 items
guideStages.text: Get immediate feedback, a short reason, and the right bin after each answer. Use Next when ready.

guideStages.title: Post-test · 10 items
guideStages.text: Sort another set without correctness hints. After the last item, choose Review my results.

guideIntro: Complete three short rounds. Each round shows one household item at a time.
guidePrivacy: Session details are optional. By default, results are saved only in this browser.
guideControls: Move an item by mouse or touch and release over a bin. While holding an item, press 1 for Wet, 2 for Dry, or 3 for Hazardous.
guideResults: The review compares before-and-after accuracy, practice score, streak, and time. It also shows items to revisit and every post-test answer. Download CSV to save the session results.
